rawContent: @RasnaWarah I plan to write a review on the Politics and Prose site (where I purchased the book) when I finish. At least 2 weeks, I am not a fast reader. Just completed The UN's #MeToo Moment. Favorably impressed. This is partly a story about power imbalances.
@RasnaWarah not sure it is what you had in mind, but I was glad to read how #MeToo and #BLM went around the globe. It is nice to know that America can export something other than bombs.
